attenuation_basis: NIST Table 3 lead values at 0.6 and 0.8 MeV; log-log interpolation to the ANL 0.7-MeV representative photon energy.
cost_basis: IMF global lead price via FRED series PLEADUSDA; 2025 annual value $1962.24983 per metric ton.
notes: Raw lead only; structural shells, fabrication, thermal design, and secondary-radiation buildup are excluded.

attenuation_basis: NIST Table 3 iron values at 0.6 and 0.8 MeV; log-log interpolation to 0.7 MeV. Elemental iron is used as the carbon-steel attenuation proxy.
cost_basis: U.S. Commerce Department March 2025 U.S. steel price of $984 per metric ton, reported by AP.
notes: Raw steel proxy only; alloy grade, plate premium, welding, machining, QA, and package fabrication are excluded.

attenuation_basis: 95W-3.5Ni-1.5Fe mass-weighted mixture of NIST elemental coefficients; each coefficient log-log interpolated from 0.6 and 0.8 MeV to 0.7 MeV.
cost_basis: Screening lower bound from the USGS 2025 estimated tungsten-concentrate price of $380 per dry metric ton unit WO3; converted to contained W and multiplied by 95 wt% W.
notes: 18.0 g/cm3 is a representative value within the published 16.85-18.85 g/cm3 WHA range. The cost is a raw contained-tungsten floor; powder conversion, Ni/Fe binder, sintering, machining, scrap, and QA are excluded.

screening_scope: Stationary or limited site-transfer sensitivity only
attenuation_basis: NIST Table 4 ordinary-concrete values at 0.6 and 0.8 MeV; log-log interpolation to 0.7 MeV.
cost_basis: 2025 U.S. average ready-mix selling price $179.95 per cubic yard, converted using 2300 kg/m3.
notes: Not presented as a normal over-the-road cask material. Ready-mix only; reinforcement, forms, placement, curing, structural shell, and package certification are excluded.
